async def act(page):
    # Hover over the 'Content' link in the menubar to open its dropdown menu
    await page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name=" Content").hover()
    # Wait for the dropdown menu to appear
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Click on the 'Pages' link within the dropdown menu
    await page.get_by_role("menu").get_by_role("link", name="Pages").click()
    # Wait for the Pages list page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # On the Pages list, find the 'Enable Cookies' page and click to edit it
    # Use filter to find the row with the page titled 'Enable Cookies' and click the edit link/button
    await page.get_by_role("row").filter(has=page.get_by_text("Enable Cookies")).get_by_role("link", name="Edit").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # In the edit page, find the title field and change it to 'Cookie monster coming to your place'
    # Assuming the title field is a textbox with role 'textbox' and name 'Title' or similar
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title").fill("Cookie monster coming to your place")
    # Save the changes by clicking the save button
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save Page").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
